jsonld.name: Douara Offal Skewers
jsonld.description: The douara carts work the medina's night edges: tripe and lung and heart, par-cooked in the afternoon's big pot, then threaded on skewers and grilled fierce over coals, dusted with cumin and salt, and eaten standing with bread and the fierce harissa. Offal's argument at its most direct — the long-cooked softening of the offal kitchen and the fast fire of the grill joined in one dish — and the medina's most honest food, because nothing about it pretends.

1 onion (about 150 g), halved; 3 cloves garlic (about 12 g), smashed; 2 bay leaves; 1 tsp salt — the par-cook's pot
2 tbsp neutral oil (about 25 g); 1 tbsp cumin; 1 tsp sweet paprika; ½ tsp chile flakes; salt and black pepper — the grill dust

Drain, cool enough to handle, and cube to the skewer's measure. Reserve a cup of the pot's broth for the bread's dunk at the table, the carts' own mercy.

Checkpoint: the target is char at the edges, hot through, and the spice dust toasted onto the blisters — the fire's 10 minutes are for the crust, the pot having done the tender. Under-charred douara is a boiled skewer, and the street would say so.

Douara Offal Skewers

Moroccan · Medium · Serves 4

Jump to Recipe Method Troubleshooting Storage
The douara carts work the medina's night edges: tripe and lung and heart, par-cooked in the afternoon's big pot, then threaded on skewers and grilled fierce over coals, dusted with cumin and salt, and eaten standing with bread and the fierce harissa. Offal's argument at its most direct — the long-cooked softening of the offal kitchen and the fast fire of the grill joined in one dish — and the medina's most honest food, because nothing about it pretends.

Quantities live in the recipe card.

Ingredients

  • the par-cook's pot
  • the grill dust
- **Par-cook first — always.** Offal straight to the grill is rubber; the same pieces simmered 45–60 minutes first arrive at the fire tender and needing only its char. The two-stage clock (the pot's softening, the fire's blistering) is the douara's whole engineering, and it is the same doctrine the #105's sibling traditions run. - **The bridge:** the tripe wants the butcher's initial cleaning plus your own final rinse; the heart and lung want their tubes and clots trimmed. The mix is honest in any proportion — all heart for the beginner, the full mix for the tradition.

Douara Offal Skewers

Prep: 30 minutes, plus 1 hour par-cooking · Cook: 12 minutes · Total: About 1 hour 45 minutes · Serves 4

Ingredients

Ingredients

  • 600 g mixed beef or lamb offal: tripe (well-cleaned), heart, and lung in roughly equal parts (about 200 g each), cut to 3 cm pieces
  • 1 onion (about 150 g), halved; 3 cloves garlic (about 12 g), smashed; 2 bay leaves; 1 tsp salt — the par-cook's pot
  • 2 tbsp neutral oil (about 25 g); 1 tbsp cumin; 1 tsp sweet paprika; ½ tsp chile flakes; salt and black pepper — the grill dust
  • Flat metal or soaked wooden skewers; bread (about 250 g); #91 harissa thinned with oil; lemon wedges; sliced onion soaked in vinegar

Instructions

  1. **The par-cook (1 hour at a murmur).** Simmer the offal pieces with the onion, garlic, bay, and salt in water to cover — the barest tremble, roughly 90 °C — until the heart yields to a knife's tip and the tripe runs soft-firm (not collapse): 45 minutes for heart and lung, up to 75 for the tripe. Drain, cool enough to handle, and cube to the skewer's measure. Checkpoint — the par-cooked pieces should be fully tender but holding — the pot has done the softening, and the fire's work is still ahead. Reserve a cup of the pot's broth for the bread's dunk at the table, the carts' own mercy.
  2. **Skewer and grill fierce (10–12 minutes).** Thread the cubes loosely on the skewers and grill over the hottest coals — turning every 2 minutes, patient for the char in patches — until the edges blister and crisp and the smoke rises. Dust with the cumin-paprika-chile-salt mix at each of the last two turns. Checkpoint — the target is char at the edges, hot through, and the spice dust toasted onto the blisters — the fire's 10 minutes are for the crust, the pot having done the tender. Under-charred douara is a boiled skewer, and the street would say so.
  3. **Serve with the full mercy-plate.** The skewers to hand with bread, the harissa thinned, the lemon, the vinegar-soaked onion — and the broth's cup for the dunk. Checkpoint — eating test: the char's smoke and the cumin's earth over the tripe's soft chew, the heart's firm bite, the lung's light sponginess — each texture distinct on the same skewer, the harissa's fire and lemon's cut between, the bread carrying all. It should taste like the night medina's working food: complete, unpretentious, andfiercer than the day's kitchen.

Troubleshooting

SymptomCauseFix
Skewers rubberyPar-cook short or grill rushedThe full simmer; the full 10-minute char
Tripe's odor at the potUnder-cleanedThe final rinse, the vinegar splash
Offal fell to the coalsOver-simmered to fallingTender-but-holding, the knife-tip test

Storage, Make-Ahead & Variations

- The par-cooked offal keeps 2 days refrigerated (the carts' own schedule — the afternoon pot, the night grill) and the grill-to-order is the format. The broth keeps 3 days for the soup pot. - Variations: the heart-only version, the extra-chili night register. The #19 kebda and the #25 mombar are offal's other seats on this site; the #28 douara is the fire's.
